name: Design flow establishment
rule: Designer may provide a verified design flow directly. If so, demand calculation is not required unless independently requested or needed for another check.

name: AHJ input
rule: AHJ is optional. If omitted, the system must use the selected jurisdiction/default engineering basis and disclose that project-specific AHJ requirements were not supplied.

name: IPC Appendix E applicability
rule: Do not automatically apply Appendix E. Use it only when adopted/referenced or explicitly selected as the accepted design method.

name: Hydraulic diameter input
rule: Use actual internal pipe diameter, not nominal designation, for velocity and friction calculations. Obtain ID from verified pipe/product data.

name: Hydraulic method selection
rule: Use a recognized hydraulic method. Darcy-Weisbach is general-purpose; Hazen-Williams may be used for applicable water-piping calculations with a defensible C basis.

name: Service-water diversity
rule: When the designer has not supplied a design flow, probable simultaneous demand/diversity must be established using the applicable code or recognized method; do not assume all fixtures operate simultaneously unless justified.

name: Elevation head
rule: Include elevation between source and critical outlet in available-pressure/TDH calculations. Convert elevation to pressure/head consistently with the calculation unit system.

name: Hot-water pressure losses
rule: Include pressure losses through the heater and applicable mixing/anti-scald devices when they form part of the hydraulic path.
